title: VSD occluders
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: VSD occluder
designs.summary: A generic double-disc occluder illustrated at a muscular ventricular septal aperture.

states.label: 1. Anatomy only
states.note: An enlarged representative section; dimensions and tissue shapes are not measured on a specific patient or population.

states.label: 2. Compact illustration
states.note: A simplified narrow device pose, not a delivery instruction or a simulated deployment.

states.label: 3. Expanded illustration
states.note: A representative expanded pose. Contact, sealing, tissue deformation and flow are not calculated.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the region
views.lesson: The enlarged marker orients the separate representative diagrams.

views.label: Ventricles and septum
views.title: See the opening in the real muscular septum
views.lesson: Both ventricles come from a real heart model with walls added, cut across midway between base and tip and seen from the base. The thick muscular septum lies between them. The position of the opening is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Tissue section
views.title: See both sides of the tissue
views.lesson: A generic muscular septal aperture is shown here. Other VSD locations and adjacent valves are outside this illustration.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: See the three-dimensional relationship
views.lesson: A representative oblique view separates the near and far components.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look toward the channel
views.lesson: Use this complementary view to distinguish tissue, the device and the opening.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

wall.label: MUSCULAR SEPTUM
wall.body: This thicker panel represents a muscular ventricular septal region; it does not depict a perimembranous defect or nearby conduction tissue.

aperture.label: TRUE APERTURE
aperture.body: This opening passes through the representative septal wall. The section reveals its continuous rim.

waist.label: CONNECTING WAIST
waist.body: The narrow middle lies within the illustrated aperture between the two retention discs.

disc.label: RETENTION DISCS
disc.body: Two expanded discs lie on opposing faces of the representative wall. These generic shapes do not represent a product.

compact.label: COMPACT POSE
compact.body: The narrow illustration contrasts with the expanded pose; a sheath and delivery sequence are omitted.

region_RV.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_RV.body: The right ventricle wraps around the septum as a crescent, seen here in cross-section.

region_LV.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
region_LV.body: The left ventricle is the round chamber, seen here in cross-section with its thick wall.

region_septum.label: MUSCULAR VENTRICULAR SEPTUM
region_septum.body: The thick muscular wall shared by the two ventricles. It is much thicker than the atrial septum, so the opening runs through it like a short channel.

region_communication.label: TRUE SEPTAL OPENING
region_communication.body: A round opening runs through the muscular septum; the cut passes through it. Openings in other parts of the septum, near the valves, are not shown. The position of the opening is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_device.label: GENERIC OCCLUDER
region_device.body: One disc lies on the right ventricular face and a second disc on the left ventricular face, joined through the opening. The device is sized to this opening for the illustration and does not represent a specific product.
